info.name: When I Work API Documentation Accounts Shift Requests API
Gets a collection of all shift requests.

params.name: end
params.description: End time for the shift search window. Must be included if start is defined.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of shift requests to include per page.

params.name: open_only
params.description: Whether only open swaps should be included in the results.

params.name: page
params.description: The page of results to fetch.

params.name: shift_id
params.description: The ID of the shift to get swaps for. For multiple shifts, enter a list of shift IDs separated by commas.

params.name: start
params.description: Start time for the shift search window. Must be included if end is defined.

params.name: status
params.description:
The status or statuses of shift request that should be included in the
results. For multiple statuses, enter a list separated by commas.

Statuses available are:
* `0` - Pending
* `1` - Approved
* `2` - Declined
* `3` - Completed
* `4` - Canceled
* `5` - Expired

params.name: type
params.description:
The type or types of shift requests that should be included in the results.
For multiple types, enter a list separated by commas.

Types available are:
* `1` - Swap
* `2` - Drop
* `3` - Alert

params.name: user_id
params.description: The ID of the user to get shift requests for. For multiple users, enter a list of user IDs separated by commas.

items.docs:
Get a collection of shift request objects. Swaps let users swap shifts with each
other or drop shifts for other users to pick up.
